messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: There were no LOD peaks above the threshold.
parts:
chromosome pairs are shown if any of the following holds:

   (a) lod.full > its threshold and lod.fv1 > its threshold
OR (b) lod.full > its threshold and lod.int > its threshold
OR (c) lod.add  > its threshold and lod.av1 > its threshold

For the c1:c5 pair, lod.add and lod.av1 are both larger than their thresholds, so (c) is satisfied.

karl
